description: This file defines the 'Row' class which represents a row within a table structure in the document object model of MigraDoc. It includes properties for styling, height, Paddings, Borders, Shading, Cells, and other row-specific attributes, as well as methods for cloning, resetting cached values, serialization, and accepting visitors.

classes.name: Row
classes.description: Represents a row of a table in the document model, including styling, layout, cells, and serialization details.

classes.name: RowValues
classes.description: Encapsulates the internal nullable properties backing the Row's attributes.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the Row object.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs the actual deep cloning process of the Row, including nested objects.

methods.name: ResetCachedValues
methods.description: Resets internal cached properties to ensure proper rendering.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the Row object into a specific format for output or storage.

methods.name: AcceptVisitor
methods.description: Allows a visitor object to traverse the Row and its cells.

methods.name: Table
methods.description: Returns the table to which this row belongs, or null if not assigned.

methods.name: ResetIndex
methods.description: Sets the index of the row within its parent collection.
